open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have o2 : ∀ {A B a b S : List Expression.Ident},
      A ⊆ a ++ S → B ⊆ b ++ S → A ++ B ⊆ a ++ b ++ S := by
    intro A B a b S h₁ h₂
    simp only [List.subset_def, List.mem_append] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    rintro x (h|h)
    · exact (h₁ h).elim (Or.inl ∘ Or.inl) Or.inr
    · exact (h₂ h).elim (Or.inl ∘ Or.inr) Or.inr
  have key : ∀ (v : Expression.Ident) (s e : Expression.Expr),
      (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars (substOld v s e)).Subset
      (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars e ++ Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars s) := by
    intro v s e
    induction e with
    | const _ _ | op _ _ _ | bvar _ _ | fvar _ _ _ => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
    | abs _ _ _ ih => exact ih
    | ite _ c t f ic it iff => exact o2 (o2 ic it) iff
    | quant _ _ _ tr e iq ie => exact o2 iq ie
    | eq _ e₁ e₂ i₁ i₂ => exact o2 i₁ i₂
    | app _ fn arg ifn ia =>
        simp only [substOld]
        split
        · split
          · exact List.subset_append_right _ _
          · exact List.subset_append_left _ _
        · exact o2 ifn ia
  exact key h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post
